employees.evidence: Employees develop skills and achieve success alongside managers who invest in them

dei.evidence: We don’t just value differences—we celebrate them.

environment.evidence: At Oracle, we know that sustainability is good business.

shareholders.evidence: Oracle at 30 continues to grow and innovate

innovation.evidence: Oracle applies enterprise expertise to startup ingenuity to solve business problems

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual corporate history with a short aspirational mission line. Employee-focused 'Working @ Oracle' section gives workforce the most attention. Commitments are largely absolute ('we don't just', 'we know'), with first-person plural used sparingly. Sustainability appears only as a brief, business-framed claim, and customers receive no stated value.
